question: Does moving a single nonempty literal SAME exponent away from the word end remove the known957 triple obstruction?
origin: Root noticed disjoint old triple forms during primary review; no blind claim, source selection or new native counting.
premises: The exact957teaching grammar, including unary/binary valency, explicit initial S, carried S, and SAME/OBJECT/END finite inflections.
One complete teaching group maps injectively to one complete native whole group, by one context-independent renderer. No multiple source teaching groups share one surface form.
The retained repeated groups are whole unsplit words, not paid continuation fragments.

Every SAME finite group writes the same nonempty literal exponent. It may be prefix, suffix, infix at variable location, or split into fixed fragments, provided at least one fixed sign remains visibly present in every realization. No deletion, zero allomorph or glyph-changing contextual realization is included.
Working signs and definite group boundaries retain the old transcription binding; global bijective sign relabeling is allowed.
grammar_lemma: An identical nominal group repeated three times cannot fit the maximum two NP slots of an initial binary clause; carried clauses allow at most one written NP.
Identical binary finite groups require a written O between occurrences and cannot be adjacent triples.
A unary END finite group requires a new explicit S before its next occurrence; unary OBJECT is invalid.
Thus legal equal complete-group triples decode to a unary SAME finite group (with any same written predicate negation). This repeats assertions; it does not assign events, intensity or numbers.
physical_proof: The old all-reader chol triple is on f47r.7, source indices4,5,6. Its sign set is {ch,o,l}.
The old all-reader ytaiin triple is on f86v3.3, source indices2,3,4. Its sign set is {y,t,a,i,n}.
The two sets are disjoint, so no sign, and therefore no nonempty fixed literal exponent, can occur in both. Its location or contiguity cannot change that fact.
An injective global renaming preserves the empty intersection. No search over permutations is required.
change_from_prior: The old957RAW establishes only a fixed nonempty terminal-exponent obstruction. This consequence blocks moving that SAME literal material to any position; it does not build a carrier or expand the grammar.
decision_if_valid: Do not build a fixed nonempty literal SAME prefix/infix/suffix renderer for the unchanged957grammar and whole-group contract. Retain the incomplete abstract grammar and its original meaningful lesson.
alternatives_outside_scope: Zero SAME realization with separately paid parsing rules
Different allomorphs or state-dependent glyph realization
Noninjective whole-group rendering with source disambiguation
Changed grammar, group boundaries, primitive signs or continuation handling
claim_ceiling: Conditional two-witness exclusion of fixed nonempty literal SAME marking for the957grammar only; no native word/component meaning, general morphology ban, physical glyph adjudication, complete-writer success or source-language conclusion.
